acceptanceCriteria: Document HANDOFF/REVIEW_RETURNED stages, candidate/submit requirements, reason/refusal codes, evidence meaning and effect of policy changes on live attempts.

Provide a supported external-work handoff with no candidate tree; explicitly decide/document integrate-stage eligibility while preserving failed-gate, expiry, policy/revision, cleanup, reservation, pool and prospective accounting invariants.

Retain meaningful actual disposable CLI/store qualification, legacy compatibility, focused checks, independent review and owning-spec/CEM/OCM evidence; keep open until public integration and native completion succeed.
body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/421
Direct owner requested fixing newly filed GitHub tickets on 2026-10-01 in the ongoing all-issues batch. Preserve original complete issue intent below. Independent baseline confirms the reported behavior; no source repair or live policy/store migration performed. Core rc.1 build163; Tasks developer build202.

## Summary

PR #414 (#412) added retry-free HANDOFF and REVIEW_RETURNED releases. `docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md` doesn't mention them, and an adopter has to read `transaction/lease_handoff.go` to learn the preconditions. Two common hand-off shapes also can't qualify.

## Undocumented preconditions (from `verifyHandoff`, main @ d693d28)

- The claim must use `--stage implement` or `--stage review`. A claim without a stage, or with `--stage integrate`, is refused (`TICKET_STATE`), and REVIEW_RETURNED needs `review`.
- The attempt must be in phase BUILT or CHECKING, with a submitted `CandidateTreeOid`, `ScopeCheck == WITHIN` and no pending effects. Otherwise it is refused with `MISSING_EVIDENCE`.
- The ticket acceptance revision and policy must not have changed since the claim. A `policy update` while attempts are live makes every in-flight hand-off fail with `STALE_POLICY`.

`grep -n -i "HANDOFF\|REVIEW_RETURNED" docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md` returns nothing.

## Hand-offs that can't qualify

1. **Work outside the queue repository.** Our agents write matrices, reviews and test code in other repositories; the queue repo only tracks `.taskman/`. To qualify, an agent must `submit` the tree of the claim's `baseCommit`, which changes no paths. It can't submit `HEAD^{tree}`: an integrator commits `.taskman/` while it works, and those paths fall outside its declared scope. Submitting an unchanged tree only to unlock the accounting is a workaround, not evidence.
2. **Integrate stage.** Integrator and full-suite-baseline attempts on a reserved `integrate` lane can't hand off cleanly at all.

## Requests

- Add a hand-off section to `TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md`: stages, the submit requirement, reason codes, refusal codes, and the effect of a policy change on live attempts.
- Provide a supported hand-off for attempts whose work lives outside the queue repository, for example `release --reason HANDOFF --evidence <ref>` with no candidate tree, or an explicit "no tree" submit.
- Decide whether the `integrate` stage should get HANDOFF, and document the decision either way.
title: GH #421: corvint-tasks: document HANDOFF/REVIEW_RETURNED releases for external agents, and support hand-off without a candidate tree and at the integrate stage
